study.question: Does learning the temporal shape of explicit target-match evidence, separately for category/brand and four behavior types, improve on fixed one-day decay beyond capacity-matched amplitude scaling, and does any benefit require event-level match-age association?
study.hypothesis: Observed: r0001-aligned_time AUC 0.617149 exceeds duplicate_count 0.616631, factorized_time 0.616260 and activity_time 0.616603 under the earlier matched design. Current source still uses the same fixed 86400-second decay for every field/action; this is an observed modeling restriction, not evidence that distinct lifetimes exist. Provisional mechanism: learned field/action temporal shape may preserve target-specific recent evidence better than a uniform fixed horizon. r0005-query_blind remains incumbent at AUC 0.6186034708944973 / Logloss 0.1959999530328033. Its diagnostic history mean 118.115/128 and sparse non-pv matches limit generalization; earlier diagnostic buy-category match count was zero among first 512, so rare-action parameters may be unidentified. None of these descriptive quantities establishes causal recency.

nearest_work.difference: Nearest local temporal implementation: one fixed day half-life. Learn eight bounded horizons in the same eight decayed-match coordinates; compare to eight learned amplitudes and factorized association replacements, leaving later inherited context/retrieval fixed.

Archived exact-version primary text arXiv:1706.06978v4, section 4.3, lines 260-283; content-sha256:5fee25f33f375e51b3ee9417d376ff9dbe2ea3628c932a7679ddfeb0feaaade2, text-sha256:83fb9eeca31e2fa3c557b6f08b893ad0018cefb33da6e00952136b9ce17e607e. Inherit relevance activation idea but preserve the local normalized attention. Add a small learned temporal kernel on exact-match statistics, not DIN unnormalized pooling. This bounded source review does not establish global novelty of learned decay; novelty remains unverified.

Full publisher text unavailable. No detailed DMR mechanism reproduction or priority claim is made.

inherited_components: Exact r0005-query_blind source SHA256 9cc179ba81d736d49723b152aff730a6c43f35b31179cc964b60ff575ae04023 verified before editing.
Static field embeddings, action/recency embeddings, blind static-context queries, shared normalized category/brand relevance pooling.
Eight field/action match-count features, eight one-day match-mass coordinates to be replaced, eight fixed pair-valid support features, 128/64 MLP, Adam/lr .001 and ordinary host loss.
Frozen causal prefix, sample identity, natural prevalence, six-day training, validation-only feedback; no history item IDs or extended history.

Scene-scoped revision from immutable receipts: explicit match/time evidence has local single-seed support; joint-pair, action-pooling, availability masks, direct readouts and pooled-intensity branches did not establish gains over their closest incumbent. In r0008 all four AUCs (0.6184930, 0.6183568, 0.6182467, 0.6185011) were below r0005-query_blind 0.6186035. Successful execution and diagnostic activation do not establish predictive mechanism support. This round tests temporal shape without retaining those unsuccessful interventions. No failed host trial is reported in the supplied trajectory; null/negative results are preserved as scientific evidence.
study.proposed_difference: Add a zero-initialized [2,4] parameter tensor after all parent constructors, without random draws. For field f/action a, factor=exp(log(4)*tanh(theta[f,a])). Horizon mode replaces only the decayed-match kernel with exp(-ln(2)*age/(86400*factor)); amplitude control uses factor*exp(-ln(2)*age/86400). Both aligned cells start at the same parent predictions under identical initialized host tensors. Cross with factorized mass=match_count*learned_weighted_valid_support/max(valid_support,1). All four use identical parameter count and 24 feature positions; pair-support branch remains one-day fixed. Prediction gains, mechanisms and prior-work differences will be reported separately. No novelty claim.
predictions: Primary predeclared contrast: AUC(horizon_aligned)>AUC(amplitude_aligned) and >AUC(r0005-query_blind); Logloss should not materially worsen. An unpaired historical incumbent difference alone is insufficient.
Temporal-binding prediction: the horizon-minus-amplitude AUC contrast is larger in aligned than factorized cells. Evaluate this interaction as exploratory single-seed until paired repetitions.

Nonzero learned factors and fixed-checkpoint feature/logit changes demonstrate pathway use only. Horizon zero-age weight remains one and nonnegative mass does not exceed match count; missing target IDs and empty histories produce exact-zero target evidence.
Hypothesized action/field variation is tentative: unequal learned factors require support counts and repeats before interpretation. No action half-life ordering is preselected.
falsifiers: No aligned AUC improvement over both incumbent and amplitude control fails this implementation-level prediction.
Comparable gains in factorized cells undermine the target-match/age-binding explanation, even if predictive performance improves.
Near-unit factors with negligible feature/logit changes show this implementation did not engage the proposed mechanism; they do not test an unconstrained well-optimized kernel.
Nonfinite logits/gradients, nonzero evidence on empty/missing target histories, or changed causal inputs invalidate the run rather than count as scientific counterevidence.
alternative_explanations: One seed during screening; validation is reused across sequential adaptive proposals. No significance or causal lifetime claim.
Horizon and amplitude have different attainable functions and gradient shapes despite equal parameter counts; amplitude may be partly absorbed by classifier.
Common learning rate and bounded factor range may underfit rare action kernels; null does not refute heterogeneous recency.
First-512 checkpoint diagnostics are small, selected, candidate-supplied and descriptive only.
Additional learned amplitudes, generic feature conditioning or co-adapted classifier optimization may explain gains; the capacity-matched amplitude cells address part of this.
Static snapshot as-of dates remain undocumented; this is a benchmark attribute assumption rather than verified production point-in-time data.

Category/brand equality is measured on host-encoded IDs; if their bucket encoding collides, raw identity matching can differ (not audited anew here). Truncated-history counts are not whole-user behavior counts.

variants.name: horizon_aligned
variants.note: Prospective horizon kernel with aligned match-age statistics. Standalone source SHA256 b72c47b6269ac6be7804135e2a39f4e3d1534983c5a25b9a713b376d0312dd23. Eight additional zero-initialized parameters; expected total 17133355, embedding 17078688, dense 54667, pending host measurement. Same parent random draws, 24 evidence coordinates and MLP dimensions; only the eight decayed-match coordinates change. Host-only scratch training under frozen protocol; no new performance measured in this phase. Canonical config SHA256 7c0b72895753efa76d7495186f74a44c59a1e3c099ccbeb13df4f30f7a7a5da3 (sorted compact JSON). Local verification: runtime study schema, allowed evidence IDs, protocol, exact 2x2 grid, literal CONFIG, numeric imports, no I/O, standalone syntax and identical ASTs except CONFIG passed. Inherited pair/context/scorer ASTs and constructor prefix through output creation match the committed ancestor. Diagnostics contain 45 scalars. Independent scalar formulas passed 600 randomized cases with analytic/finite-difference derivative checks, plus missing/empty/padded histories, mass bounds, permutation, singleton/all-match degeneracies and extreme theta. A constructed pair with equal counts and fixed-day mass separates horizon shape from amplitude; swapping match-age association changes aligned but leaves factorized mass fixed. These are mathematical/source checks, not Torch execution or measured gradient/performance results. Reproduce syntax with python3 -c "import ast,pathlib; ast.parse(pathlib.Path('candidate.py').read_text())". Host reproduction: load this standalone Model(meta, exact registered config), frozen protocol 9c1635366a72f4c4f67708ee7ae9b72a1b90197ffed3485736388ceff7c91d3e, scratch seeds and 3 epochs/batch4096/Adam-lr.001; accepted proposals execute automatically, with no public local training CLI. No local training, installation, test feedback or new performance claim. Preserve incumbent until host comparison. Agent-memory provenance: proposal records the new scene-scoped hypothesis/revision; host owns append-only trial receipts and prior records remain unchanged. Only model modules and proposal.json are editable; no separate memory or human-owned material was written. Agent/paper temporal searches returned no additional registered match; DIN primary text and DMR README were read, and five industry cards were considered without transferring their performance claims. Global novelty is unverified.
